items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: When I go to Boston I seek out Sam Rivers, I look for somebody, and I play with them.

ctx.x: About people who... There some guy this town, some guy in that town, so whenever we go to these places we seek out these people. When I go to Boston I seek out Sam Rivers, I look for somebody, and I play with them. There some other piano players I should tell you about. I used to play with Jackie Byard a lot too.
